2607.13305.title: Accuracy Without Grounding: Diagnosing Visual Dependency Dissociation in Video LLM Benchmarks
2607.13305.paper_summary: Benchmark accuracy in video large language models (LLMs) is often treated as evidence of visual understanding. We audit this assumption across twenty models spanning 2-78B parameters and ten architecture families. We introduce the Visual Dependency Gap (VDG), the difference in per-question correctness between original-video and black-screen conditions. Paired McNemar tests on MVBench show that accuracy and visual dependency are separable: models differ on original video (p = 0.0003) but not on black screens (p = 0.53). Across models, task-type rankings are stable: Attribute Perception is strongly visual, whereas Temporal Reasoning approaches the language-only baseline. A diagnostic ladder from black screen to single frame, shuffled frames, and original video reveals that frame diversity supplies most of the visual benefit, while temporal order contributes near-zero accuracy across sixteen open-weight models. An ablation from 0.5 to 24 FPS rules out sparse sampling as the cause. H.264 experiments further show that stable aggregate accuracy conceals bidirectional question-level answer flips. The diagnostic also generalizes to four API-accessed models, whose VDG values range from 0.025 to 0.315. These results motivate VDG as a standard audit for whether video benchmarks measure visually grounded capability. Code is available at https://github.com/JaeLee18/accuracy-without-grounding.
2607.13305.paper_summary_zh: 基準準確性在視頻大型語言模型（LLMs）中通常被視為視覺理解的證據。<lb/>我們對二十個模型進行了審核，這些模型的參數範圍從2到78B，涵蓋了十個架構系列。<lb/>我們引入了視覺依賴差距（VDG），即原始視頻和黑屏條件下每個問題正確率之間的差異。<lb/>在MVBench上進行的配對McNemar測試顯示，準確性和視覺依賴性是可分的：模型在原始視頻上存在差異（p = 0.0003），但在黑屏上則不存在差異（p = 0.53）。<lb/>在模型之間，任務類型的排名是穩定的：屬性感知是強烈的視覺性，而時間推理接近僅基於語言的基準。<lb/>從黑屏到單幀、隨機幀和原始視頻的診斷梯度顯示，幀的多樣性提供了大部分視覺效益，而時間順序在十六個開放權重模型中幾乎不貢獻準確性。<lb/>從0.5到24 FPS的消融實驗排除了稀疏取樣作為原因。<lb/>H.264實驗進一步顯示，穩定的總體準確性掩蓋了雙向問題級別的答案翻轉。<lb/>該診斷還可以推廣到四個API訪問的模型，其VDG值範圍從0.025到0.315。<lb/>這些結果促使VDG成為標準審核，以判斷視頻基準是否測量視覺基礎能力。<lb/>代碼可在https://github.com/JaeLee18/accuracy-without-grounding獲得。
